authors: design agent, family-A lead C1 (unfrozen draft for the Coordinator)

links.note: Toy and public parameters only; planted discrete logs on curves constructed here; no deployed key.

question: On stratified prime-order toy curves of 24-40 bits, does the charged cost S of negation-map rho (and of one fixed small-x index-calculus engine at 24-28 bits) depend on the arithmetic invariants of (p, N, t, D, conductor, class number, p+-1, N+-1) by more than 5% (rho) or 15% (IC) per standard deviation or per stratum, once N and the automorphism group are accounted for?

claims.text: Every curve identity (p, a, b, N, t, j, planted k) is exact and every row's answer verifies [k]P=Q.

For rho.negation, no preregistered arithmetic invariant moves ln(S / sqrt(pi N / 4)) by more than 0.05 per standard deviation after size-bin and ln N adjustment (equivalence margin), and the A/A spread, the positive control and the null simulation behave as declared.
claims.if_supported: a measured atlas row: toy rho charged cost depends on (p,N,t) only through N within 5%; any matched-rho calibration excess is not arithmetic
claims.if_not_supported: the dependent invariant is reported as instrument bias, not as a mechanism, and LEAD-RHO-matched-rho-calibration is reopened

claims.text: For the fixed small-x IC engine, no preregistered invariant moves ln(s3_solves) by more than 0.15 per standard deviation after size-bin and ln N adjustment; underpowered invariants are reported inconclusive, not null.
claims.if_supported: constant-level IC rigidity across arithmetic strata at 24-28 bits
claims.if_not_supported: a constant-level IC dependence on the named invariant; next_action: a held-out replication at 30 bits

claims.text: Anything about deployed or standardised curves, or exponents beyond 40 bits.

hypotheses.statement: Charged rho and IC cost depend on (p, N, t) only through N, |Aut| and the step cost: every preregistered invariant's effect is inside the equivalence margin (expected, per the lead's own theorem-side analysis).
hypotheses.mechanism: Generic lower bound and endomorphism-orbit closure; isogeny-class census already shows within-class rigidity.

predictions.minimum_effect: all 12 rho invariants: 90% CI of the per-SD coefficient inside [-0.05,+0.05]

hypotheses.mechanism: For IC the small-x factor base is an integer-lift object, so p mod small primes or p-1 smoothness could move yield at the constant level; for rho any effect is instrument bias.

hypotheses.statement: The pipeline recovers planted structure: an Aut-quotient walk on j=0 curves lowers ln S by 0.5493 +- 0.05, and an injected 5% charge on one invariant level is detected.
hypotheses.mechanism: Aut of order 6 gives sqrt(2/6) fewer steps; injection multiplies the counted S in the counting layer by 1.05 keyed on a hash of the invariant bin.

predictions.minimum_effect: aut-quotient arm ln S ratio -0.549 within 0.05; injected dose 0.05 detected with Holm p below 0.05 in at least 90% of 200 replays

arms.description: matched reference: rho.negation (r=20 r-adding walk, look-ahead, cycle escape) on random prime-order curves, set A

same rho binary on 7 constructed extreme strata (Hasse-boundary trace, small |D0| mid-trace, large conductor, N-1 smooth, p-1 smooth, N+1/p+1 smooth, special-form p), 30 curves each, every curve N-paired to a random-A curve
A/A: a second random set whose curves are N-matched (|ln N ratio| <= 0.01) to set A; differs only in which random curves were drawn

parameters.population: random prime-order, 12 per size bin, N-matched to A

arms.description: A/A: 90 curves from the extreme strata re-run on a random isomorphic model (a*u^4, b*u^6, point mapped), same curve different presentation; separates construction route from invariants
fixed small-x IC engine (enumerate, m=2, default factor base and arity) on random curves at 24, 26, 28 bits
same IC engine on the 7 strata, 4 per stratum per bin
positive control: 30 prime-order j=0 curves (|Aut|=6, p=1 mod 3) run with the Aut-quotient walk and, on the same curves and seeds, the negation-only walk; known effect ln(sqrt(1/3)) = -0.549 in ln S

positive control through the same counting layer: reruns of the rho-random-A and rho-strata rows with the counting layer multiplying S by 1+delta, delta in {0.03,0.05,0.10}, on curves whose keyed invariant bin is selected by a sealed key
negative control: for every real curve row keep N and the invariant vector but replace S by a draw from the generic rho law (fitted on set A only), 1000 simulated datasets through the full analysis

positive.expected_detection: the regression with Holm correction flags the injected invariant at delta=0.05 in >=90% of 200 replays and recovers the dose within 0.02 ln; the j=0 Aut-quotient arm shows ln S ratio -0.549 +- 0.05; a miss at 0.05 means the instrument cannot support a 5% equivalence claim and every null is declared inconclusive

null_population.description: S drawn from the generic rho law at the real curve's exact N, independent of every invariant
null_population.generator: parametric draw (gamma with fitted mean and CV from set A), seed from protocol hash
null_population.why_n: 1000 simulated datasets resolve a family-wise error of 0.05 to +-0.014 (binomial)

factors.name: N and size bin
factors.how: exact N recorded; the response is divided by the exact floor sqrt(pi N/4); size-bin fixed effects and ln(N/2^bin) are in the model; every stratum curve is N-paired (|ln ratio|<=0.01) to a random curve; invariants are scale-free (ratios of logs), so they are not proxies for N

factors.name: Aut group
factors.how: j=0 and j=1728 curves are excluded from the main strata and used only in rho-aut-j0

factors.name: construction route
factors.how: CM/sieve route vs random route; separated by rho-presentation and a route covariate in a sensitivity model; stratum is never a random effect because it would absorb the invariants under test

factors.name: curve presentation
factors.how: main arms use the generator's model; rho-presentation uses random u

factors.name: binary and build
factors.how: one binary for all rho arms; one commit

factors.name: walk seed, planted k, generator P
factors.how: sha256(protocol_sha256|arm|curve_id|replicate) per the protocol-hash rule; k uniform in [1,N-1]; P a hashed random non-identity point

factors.name: arm order
factors.how: curves shuffled by hashed key and interleaved across arms; counted metrics do not depend on order

factors.name: host load
factors.how: no clock is a metric; steal and PSI recorded per row for diagnostics only

factors.name: field step cost (special-form p reduction)
factors.how: counted in field ops only; reduction cost is invisible to counts, so no clock claim is made

comparisons.threshold: 90% CI of every per-SD coefficient inside [-0.05,+0.05] in ln S
90% CI of every per-SD coefficient inside [-0.15,+0.15] in ln S3

seed_derivation.note: curve construction, walk seeds, planted k, and the held-out third (sha256 of the curve identity mod 3 == 0) all derive from the frozen protocol hash

instance_sampling.rule: each curve is the first hit of a gp search seeded by sha256(protocol_sha256|stratum|bin|index) satisfying the stratum predicate with prime N; random-B curves are the first hit with |ln(N/N_A)|<=0.01 for the paired A curve; no curve is dropped after its cost is seen

blinding.how: the analysis script receives rows keyed by curve id with stratum names replaced by hashed labels and the injection key sealed; unmasked after the script and its sha256 are frozen

power.note: family = 12 invariants x 2 meters (rho S, IC s3) + 2 held-out omnibus tests = 26; Freedman-Lane max-T permutation with N=19999 resamples gives minimum p 2/(N+1)=1.0e-4 < alpha/m=1.9e-3. Resolution only. Test-specific power: rho per-curve ln S has SE about 0.52/sqrt(64)=0.065, so a per-SD slope over 330 curves has SE about 0.0036 and a 30-vs-30 stratum contrast has SE about 0.017 (90% CI half-width 0.028 inside the 0.05 margin). IC has 120 curves x 3 replicates, unknown CV: a sizing pilot of 40 random 26-bit curves, excluded from the data, sets the IC margin; if the stratum SE exceeds 0.09 the IC verdict is inconclusive by rule. The positive control reports the empirical detection rate at 0.03, 0.05 and 0.10.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: design-time estimate (not measured): rho at 2^20 steps/run about 1.5 s extrapolated; IC 24 bit 1.3 s and 28 bit 10 s measured in a one-off foreground probe on the 4-core design host

primary.name: ln normalised rho S
primary.definition: per curve, ln of the mean over 64 verified runs of total group additions plus doublings (setup scalar multiplications for 20 table entries and each walk start, look-ahead retries, cycle-escape doublings, abandoned walks) from the first target-dependent operation to the verified key, divided by sqrt(pi N/4) with the exact N; canonicalisation, DP storage and verification are not in S but are reported

primary.name: ln IC s3 solves
primary.definition: per curve, ln of the mean over 3 verified solves of the engine's s3_solves counter, fixed engine and parameters; group_ops, la_ops, relations and attempts recorded as separate columns, never summed

secondary.name: BSGS S (instrument-null meter)
secondary.definition: negation-map BSGS with table m=ceil(sqrt(N/2)); the table is target independent so this meter can depend on invariants only through N: a built-in zero for the regression

secondary.name: field operations
secondary.definition: affine add = 1 inv + 2 mul + 1 sqr, double = 1 inv + 2 mul + 2 sqr, canonicalisation = 1 negation (uncharged, own counter); recorded per row, the derived mul-equivalent uses a frozen inversion weight of 10 as a sensitivity only

secondary.name: IC relation yield
secondary.definition: relations found per decomposition attempt of the fixed engine

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 450 curve identities, 64 rho runs each, 3 IC solves on 120 curves; stop when every planned row is verified or recorded as failed

a curve whose gp search yields no hit within 2e6 trials is recorded as unconstructible and its stratum-bin cell is reported short; no other curve is substituted after any cost is seen, only the next index of the same seeded stream before the run

invalidation_rules: a row whose [k]P != Q is excluded and reported (wrong_answer)
a curve whose identity fails the independent gp check (N prime, p prime, N = p+1-t, order of P) is excluded before any run
a run exceeding 50 sqrt(N) steps is recorded censored and kept in the mean at its cap, with the count reported

decision_rule.text: Per meter and per invariant, fit ln S on size-bin fixed effects, ln(N/2^bin) and the 12 standardised invariants (OLS, stratum-clustered SE). Freedman-Lane max-T permutation (19999 resamples, within size bin) with Holm over 26 tests gives p-values. Rigidity is supported for an invariant when its 90% CI lies inside the margin (0.05 rho, 0.15 IC); it is violated when Holm p<0.05, the CI excludes 0 and |coef| exceeds the margin, and the sign and size replicate on the held-out third; otherwise inconclusive. The pipeline is valid only if the A/A set difference is inside its permutation interval, the injected 5% dose is detected in >=90% of replays, the Aut-quotient arm recovers -0.549+-0.05, and the null simulator rejects family-wise <=0.05 (upper 95% bound <=0.065).
decision_rule.threshold: coef 90% CI inside [-0.05,0.05] (rho) or [-0.15,0.15] (IC); violation needs Holm p<0.05 and held-out replication
decision_rule.statistic: OLS coefficient per standard deviation of the invariant on ln S; plus N-paired stratum mean difference
decision_rule.interval: 90% for equivalence, 95% for violation, stratum-cluster bootstrap
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: change in ln S per standard deviation (and per stratum vs N-paired random curves)

graphs: coefficient forest plot with margin band, per meter
stratum minus N-paired random difference with A/A interval

inadmissible: changing N, seeds, strata, invariant list, margins or the counted unit after seeing results
dropping or replacing a curve after its cost is known
a clock or a field-cost model offered as evidence of a step-cost effect
adding invariants after the look, or reading a non-preregistered correlation as a finding
reading any rho dependence as a mechanism rather than instrument bias
claiming an exponent or any statement beyond 40 bits or about deployed curves
a null stated without the passing positive control at the 5% dose

literature.claim: within-class rigidity of rho and BSGS; this study varies (p,N,t) across classes

literature.verified_by: cited by lead file, not re-read

literature.ref: Freedman and Lane 1983, A nonstrict randomization test for regression coefficients
literature.claim: permutation test of a coefficient with nuisance covariates
